eligibility_rules: Require a verified first driver-confirmation evidence date after the frozen training cutoff.
Do not substitute source release, file modification, HGNC update, or download date for first evidence date.
Canonical database membership or a text-mined mention alone does not prove a first confirmation date.
Exclude genes used in any historical training, tuning, or test-based selection under the relevant protocol.
Resolve identities and de-duplicate by HGNC before excluding overlaps.
Check feature and knowledge-graph source times; if future information is present, do not claim a fully time-isolated discovery experiment.
Lock model, ranking universe and K before evaluating the temporal list.
forbidden_inferences: Unknown genes are not true negatives for full classification AP/AUC.
Randomly re-splitting previously used genes does not by itself restore test independence.
blocking_information: Reproducible strict training/negative-proxy protocol has not been released.
Training evidence cutoff and first evidence dates are unresolved.
No independently adjudicated post-cutoff positive list is available.
